notes: 10 of 56 exposures in the light curve (aperture method, 5 wavelength bins of 1.0% per detector, bins spanning >= 30 d).
Relative magnitudes: each point against the mean magnitude of its own detector and wavelength bin; the same detector does not mean the same wavelength (linear variable filter).
37 exposures are saturated (OVERFLOW in the aperture: lower limits) and excluded; for a star saturated everywhere use method='wing' (relative brightness of the unsaturated PSF wing).
Control: 5 comparison stars measured with the aperture method in the same exposures; robust scatter (mag) D1 0.018.
Offline FITS measurement using WS3 variability methods; not a new R05 validation.
Fixed sky position. This calculation does not follow proper motion or parallax.
Aperture flux is uncorrected aperture flux; wing flux is relative surface brightness only.
Relative magnitudes are normalized per detector/wavelength bin; negative means brighter.
zero_point_mag is reported but not applied; rel_mag_err is statistical, read comparison controls for systematics.
A truncated selection may alter a period estimate. Inspect significance, aliases and independent data.
